requiredTests.name: publicPeerVectorMatchesKeyAgreementTranscriptAndBothDirections
requiredTests.oracle: Exact external request/response ciphertext and plaintext match through real platform ECDH and production derivation/cipher.

requiredTests.name: publicPeerCiphertextMutationsFailClosedAndFreshControlRecovers
requiredTests.oracle: Body/tag mutations, truncation and reflected direction fail closed and each retains a valid control.

requiredTests.name: publicPeerTranscriptMutationCannotAuthenticateTheCanonicalRequest
requiredTests.oracle: A single transcript mutation cannot authenticate the canonical request; unchanged control succeeds.

requiredTests.name: publicPeerCounterOneCannotBeReplayedAsCounterTwo
requiredTests.oracle: A successfully decrypted counter-one message cannot be replayed as counter two.

requiredTests.name: foreignGattCannotDeliverDataOrCompleteAnOperation
requiredTests.oracle: Only the owned GATT can deliver data or complete the pending native operation.

requiredTests.name: notificationSnapshotsBytesAndIgnoresUnknownCharacteristics
requiredTests.oracle: Notification bytes are copied at callback delivery and unknown characteristics are ignored.

requiredTests.name: disconnectIsTerminalAndLateCallbacksCannotReviveSession
requiredTests.oracle: Disconnect produces one terminal result, closes owned resources and suppresses late callbacks.

requiredTests.name: closeUnblocksPendingConnectionWithoutAdvancingVirtualTime
requiredTests.oracle: Cancellation unblocks pending connect immediately and disposes owned GATT.

requiredTests.name: writeWaitsForMatchingCompletionAndDiscardsAlreadyDeliveredDuplicates
requiredTests.oracle: Writes wait for the matching completion; an already queued obsolete callback cannot acknowledge a new write.

requiredTests.name: cccdCompletionMustBelongToTheSubscribedCharacteristic
requiredTests.oracle: Descriptor UUID alone cannot acknowledge subscription to a different characteristic.

requiredTests.name: wrongPeerAndQueuedDuplicateCannotAcknowledgeANotification
requiredTests.oracle: Only the selected peer can acknowledge notifications and already queued duplicates are discarded.

requiredTests.name: disconnectWhileSendingUnblocksNotificationAndFreshRoleRecovers
requiredTests.oracle: Disconnect releases a blocked notification and a fresh role can send.

requiredTests.name: wrongPeerWritesAndDuplicateTerminationDoNotDiscloseOrRetainResources
requiredTests.oracle: Wrong-peer writes cannot inject data and repeated termination disposes resources once.

requiredTests.name: foreignPeripheralCannotInjectNotificationsOrDisconnectTheSelectedPeer
requiredTests.oracle: Foreign CoreBluetooth peripheral callbacks cannot inject bytes or terminate the selected connection.

requiredTests.name: backpressureRequiresTheMatchingReadyCallbackAndAnActuallyWritableQueue
requiredTests.oracle: A ready callback releases backpressure only for the selected peer and when CoreBluetooth reports writable capacity.

requiredTests.name: disconnectUnblocksSendingDisposesOnceAndFreshSessionRecovers
requiredTests.oracle: Disconnect interrupts pending sends, disposes once and permits a fresh session.

requiredTests.name: readMatchesCharacteristicAndSubscriptionChecksNativeState
requiredTests.oracle: Read completion matches its characteristic and notification subscription confirms native state.

requiredTests.name: backpressurePreservesExactPacketOrderAndCancellationDisposesOnce
requiredTests.oracle: Peripheral backpressure preserves packet order; cancellation disposes owned resources once.

requiredTests.name: unsubscribeUnblocksSendingWithoutWaitingForTheOuterDeadline
requiredTests.oracle: Selected-peer unsubscribe releases blocked sending without waiting for the outer deadline.

requiredTests.name: selectedPeerWritesReachTheChannelAndOtherPeerCannotInjectOrTerminate
requiredTests.oracle: Only selected-peer writes reach the incoming channel or terminate the connection.
